WITH race_counts AS (
  SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS constructor_result_count
  FROM constructorResults
  GROUP BY raceId
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(constructor_result_count) AS total_count
  FROM race_counts
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT rc.raceId, rc.constructor_result_count,
         1.0 * rc.constructor_result_count / total.total_count AS ratio
  FROM race_counts AS rc
  CROSS JOIN total
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM ratios
)
SELECT ratios.raceId,
       ratios.constructor_result_count,
       ratios.ratio,
       ratios.ratio - average_ratio.avg_ratio AS difference
FROM ratios
CROSS JOIN average_ratio
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
